ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: Production maximum
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: Maximum active enemies in a reachable 25-minute build: four evolved weapons, two bosses, elites, Roster II, Harvesters, and crowded pickup and hostile-shot fields.

ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: Max density
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: Every population cap saturated simultaneously with all six weapons evolved. This is an engineering headroom probe beyond the reachable four-weapon build, not a normal-run performance claim.

ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: Triple boss
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: Three simultaneous bosses with a boss-capped enemy field. Isolates boss rendering, beam telegraphs and boss attack scans from ambient enemy cost.

ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: Red Nebula meteor storm
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: Red Nebula at full meteor occupancy with every explosive slot filled, driving chain detonations, blast waves and area damage queries on top of a full enemy field.

ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: White Sakura elite cadence
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: White Sakura Space with a saturated elite field. Combines the heaviest decorative backdrop (petal motes) with the most telegraph-heavy enemy mix.

ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Name: Soak
ContentCatalog.StressScenarios.Intent: Sustained high load over a long window. Measures frame-pacing drift, heap growth and thermal behaviour rather than peak throughput.

HydraContent.Arena.Description: A viridian ossuary grown around a toxic neural organism.

MonochromeContent.Arena.Name: Monochrome Court

NullCityContent.Arena.Name: Null City
NullCityContent.Arena.Description: An illuminated alien city that turns its infrastructure against intruders.
